about-company.docs: The culture of a company: a strip of three pictures, the heading, a few figures and the values. Axes: layout (split: the pictures beside the text, stacked: the pictures under it), tone, density.

about-me.docs: A personal about section beside a portrait: a badge, the heading, a lead, then key facts and a list of specialities, or skill chips and expertise bars, and one or two links. Axes: layout (facts, skills), mediaSide, tone.

action-group.docs: One or two calls to action side by side: a filled primary button and an outline secondary one. Links, not handlers: the page decides what they open.

rows.desc: text of the secondary action; none: one action
rows.name: secondary

activity-feed.docs: A panel with recent events: a timeline with dots on a line, or a list of rows with an icon. Axes: layout (timeline, list), density (default, compact), tone (default, muted).

alert.docs: Alert renders a div with alert or status semantics.

announcement-bar.docs: A thin strip above the page: an icon, one sentence, a link and an optional close button. Axes: tone (default, muted), layout (center, split), dismiss (show, hide).

rows.desc: accessible name of the close button
rows.name: dismissLabel

rows.desc: the tag before the sentence, e.g. New
rows.name: badgeLabel

rows.desc: bottom: stays at the bottom edge of the page while it scrolls
rows.name: position

app-main.docs: The main column of AppShell: the heading, the metric tiles, and the chart panel (beside the activity panel when `activity` is given).

rows.desc: the activity panel beside the chart; none: the chart alone
rows.name: activity

app-shell.docs: The frame of a signed-in app with a first screen in it. Axes: layout (sidebar: navigation on the left, top: a bar above the content, panes: a narrow navigation, a list and a detail), density. The collapse of the sidebar is a port contract.

rows.desc: the signed-in person, under the sidebar
rows.name: user

rows.desc: the search field of the top bar
rows.name: search

article-body.docs: A long read: sections with headings, text and an optional pull quote, in one reading column or beside a table of contents that links to each section. Axes: layout (column, toc), quotes (show, hide), tone. Highlighting the section being read is a port contract.

auth-card.docs: A sign-in, sign-up or password reset card: heading, one sentence, the fields of the mode, a submit button, optional alternative sign-in buttons and a link to the other mode. Axes: mode (signin, signup, reset), layout (card, plain), social (none, show).

rows.desc: the question before the link to the other mode
rows.name: switchText

rows.desc: first: the other sign-in buttons come before the fields
rows.name: social

auth-form.docs: The form of AuthCard: the fields of the mode (sign-in, sign-up, reset, magic link), remember me and the forgot link, the terms, the submit button.

rows.desc: the id of the card: field ids are <id>-email, <id>-password, ...
rows.name: id

auth-layout.docs: A whole sign-in page: the AuthCard placed in the page. Axes: layout (split: a picture panel beside the card, centered: the card on a tinted page, minimal: the card alone in a narrow column), side (end, start: the side of the picture), mode, social. The page's heading is the card's title.

rows.desc: the way to the other mode (sign up instead, sign in instead)
rows.name: switchTo

rows.desc: the picture panel of layout split
rows.name: visual

avatar.docs: An image in a round frame (recipe: size xs to xl, 24 to 64 px). Avatars are always round.

backdrop.docs: Something behind the children: a faint full-size picture (image), or nothing (none: the children as they are, no wrapper).

badge.docs: Badge renders label text in a div wrapper.

rows.desc: color preset: default, secondary, destructive, outline
rows.name: variant

badge-square.docs: A keyboard hint or counter in a small pill. Colours come from the middle layer (.badge-kbd).

bar-chart.docs: A row of vertical bars (sales by day, orders by week) with a caption under each bar. The chart is one image for assistive technology: `label` carries the summary, the bar values are in the captions and titles.

rows.desc: id, caption, value; `title` is the tooltip, `muted` dims a period without data
rows.name: bars

rows.desc: the summary read to assistive technology
rows.name: label

rows.desc: the value of a full-height bar; the largest value by default
rows.name: max

rows.desc: height of the plot area in px
rows.name: height

before-after.docs: Two columns that set life without the product against life with it, point by point. Axes: layout (cards: two cards, rows: one row per point), icons (show, hide), tone, density.

bento-grid.docs: Tiles of different sizes in one grid: the large and wide tiles hold the important features. Sizes come from the data (large, wide, small). Axes: layout (bento, even: all tiles alike), media (none, image: a picture in the large tiles), tone, density.

block.docs: Block renders a resolved landmark element with children.

rows.desc: semantic landmark: main, header, section, footer, nav, article, aside, figure
rows.name: tag

bottom-nav.docs: An app-style tab bar for a phone: an icon over a label per tab, the current one marked. Axes: labels (show, hide: icons only with the name hidden), position (static, sticky: stays at the bottom of the page), tone.

box.docs: Box renders a div layout wrapper.

rows.desc: div only. Use Block for landmarks (aside, section, header, nav).
rows.name: tag

breadcrumb.docs: Breadcrumb renders the full navigation trail.

bulk-bar.docs: The "N selected" bar of a list: a count, a clear button and the bulk actions (children). All text comes in through props.

rows.desc: accessible name of the clear button
rows.name: clearLabel

button.docs:
Button renders a button element, or an anchor when Href is set.
Type/Form apply only in button mode; Disabled on anchors uses aria-disabled.

rows.desc: appearance preset: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link
rows.name: variant

rows.desc: density preset: default, sm, lg, icon
rows.name: size

rows.desc: button type: button, submit, reset (ignored when Href is set)
rows.name: type

rows.desc: when set, renders an anchor with button appearance
rows.name: href

rows.desc: explicit rel; external links default to noopener noreferrer (anchor mode)
rows.name: rel

rows.desc: opens in a new tab with safe rel defaults (anchor mode)
rows.name: external

button-plain.docs: ButtonPlain is a bare button element: no styling beyond Class. Patterns (tabs, tree rows, menu items) style it themselves.

rows.desc: button type: button, submit, reset (ignored when Href is set)
rows.name: type

card.docs: Card renders the bordered surface wrapper.
CardTitle renders heading text at the As level (default h2).
CardDescription renders a muted subtitle in a p element.
CardContent renders the padded main body slot.
CardFooter renders the bottom action slot.

cart-drawer.docs: The cart drawer in its open state, over a faded page: the head with a close button, the lines with a quantity field, the free-delivery bar, the totals and the button. The empty state shows an icon, a line and the way back. Static markup: opening and closing are the page's. Axes: state (filled, empty), media (image, none).

cart-list.docs: The lines of a cart as a table or as cards: product, variant, price, quantity, line total and a remove button. Axes: layout (table, cards), media (image, none), density, tone.

cart-summary-card.docs: The order summary card of the cart page and the checkout: the lines in short (optional), a promo code field with ready codes, the free-delivery progress, the totals, the button and a note. Static markup.

rows.desc: show: the lines in short at the top
rows.name: items

rows.desc: how far the order is towards free delivery, 0 to 100
rows.name: value

cart-table.docs: The lines of a cart as a table (the table layout of CartList): product, price, quantity, line total and a remove button.

category-nav.docs: Navigation between product categories as chips, a bar with an underline, a side list, tiles with a big icon, or chips under a toolbar (search, sort and the number shown). The current one carries aria-current. Axes: layout (chips, bar, sidebar, tiles, toolbar), count (show, hide), icon (show, hide), density.

rows.desc: the toolbar layout: labels of the search, the sort and the number shown
rows.name: tools

chart-panel.docs: A panel with a chart of one series: vertical bars with captions, or meter rows with a percent. Axes: chart (bars, meters), size (default, compact), tone (default, muted).

rows.desc: template of a meter caption, e.g. `{0}%`
rows.name: percent

checklist.docs: An onboarding checklist: the tasks with a done mark, a progress bar or a count. Axes: layout (card, plain), progress (bar, text, none), marker (check, number), tone (default, muted).

rows.desc: template of the count, e.g. `{0} of {1} done`
rows.name: progressLabel

rows.desc: expand: the sentence of a task opens under its title
rows.name: detail

checkout-form.docs: A checkout on one page: contacts, address, a delivery window, the payment and the consent as stacked steps, beside a sticky order summary with the lines, a promo code and the totals. Static markup. Axes: layout (cards: each step in a card, numbered: numbered steps divided by a line), summary (aside, none), tone.

rows.desc: section heading; empty: no heading (the page heading names the checkout)
rows.name: title

checkout-step.docs: One step of a long form: an optional number, a heading (h2) and a line of text over the fields (`children`). Axes: layout (cards: the step in a card, numbered: a number beside the heading and a line between steps).

rows.desc: the number of the step (shown in the numbered layout)
rows.name: number

code-window.docs: A terminal or code window: a title bar with three round marks, then the lines. A `command` line starts with the prompt, an `output` line is muted. Static: the typing animation belongs to the port (TypingText contract).

rows.desc: name of the window, also its accessible name
rows.name: title

rows.desc: the mark before a command line
rows.name: prompt

compare-mark.docs: One cell value of ComparisonTable: yes shows a check, no a dash (both with the hidden word for screen readers), any other value is shown as text.

rows.desc: yes, no or a short text
rows.name: value

comparison-table.docs: Plans, or a product and its competitors, as three columns and the features as rows. A value of yes shows a check, no a dash (both with a hidden word), anything else is shown as text. Axes: highlight (none, middle column), tone, density.

rows.desc: middle: the second column stands out
rows.name: highlight

contact-form.docs: A contact section: a form (name, email, subject, message, consent) and, in the split layout, the ways to reach us beside it. Axes: layout (single, split), fields (short: email and message, full), terms (show, hide), tone (default, muted).

rows.desc: the ways to reach us, shown beside the form in the split layout
rows.name: details

rows.desc: full: a page of its own, a narrow form in the middle with a roomy heading
rows.name: page

container.docs: Container renders the outer content shell.

cookie-banner.docs: A consent notice: an icon, a heading, one paragraph and the buttons accept, decline and (optionally) settings. Axes: layout (bar, card), actions (two, three), tone (default, muted).

rows.desc: text of the third button, shown when `actions` is three
rows.name: settings

credit-packs.docs: Packs of credits as tiles: the amount, a badge, the price and a buy button. Axes: columns (2, 4), item (tile, row), tone, density.

rows.desc: badge word by pack badge (popular, best)
rows.name: badges

cta-actions.docs: The actions of a call to action: one or two links (ActionGroup), or an email field with a button (actions form).

cta-band.docs: A closing call to action: a heading, one sentence and one or two links. Axes: layout (card, band, split picture, row: heading beside the button in a card), tone, actions (one, two, form: an email field), proof (none, quote), density.

rows.desc: the links (mode one or two) or the email field (mode form)
rows.name: actions

rows.desc: card: boxed; band: full-width; split: text beside picture; row: heading beside button; banner: centered muted card with one button
rows.name: layout

cta-banner.docs: A centered closing card: heading, one sentence and a pill button. Sizes from the default preset.

cta-proof.docs: A call to action with proof: a badge, the heading, a lead, the proof, one or two actions and an optional note. Axes: layout (center: everything centred, the proof above the actions; split: beside a picture), proof (logos, features, stats, rows, zones), mediaSide, tone.

rows.desc: a short pill above the heading
rows.name: badge

rows.desc: a small line under the actions
rows.name: note

cta-proof-items.docs: The proof of CtaProof. Shapes: logos (six names with a glyph), features (small features in two columns), stats (three figures), rows (four icon rows), zones (delivery zones: name and areas, price and time).

rows.desc: the centered layout: items centred in their cells
rows.name: center

dashboard-overview.docs: The first screen of an app: counters, a chart and recent activity. Axes: layout (split: the chart and the activity side by side, stacked: one below the other), cols (2, 4), tone, density.

dashboard-shell.docs: The frame of a signed-in app around placeholder content. Axes: topbar (full: across the whole shell, inset: over the content column only, none), search (show, hide: the search field of the top bar), sidebar (wide, rail, collapsed: the static collapsed state, twolevel: a rail and a section panel, none: the top bar carries the links), side (start, end), footer (full, inset, none), content (grid, split, list), frame (window: a framed window in a section, page: the whole page). Collapsing the sidebar is a port contract.

rows.desc: the brand, the links of both levels and the texts of the shell
rows.name: nav

delivery-info.docs: How delivery works: the facts as icon cards, then the zones with their time and the order that ships free. Axes: layout (full: facts over zone cards, facts: the facts only, split: the facts beside a list of zones), tone, density.

dialog.docs: Dialog renders a native dialog element.

disclosure.docs: Summary renders native summary, followed by a Lucide chevron-down indicator that turns over when the details open (CSS only: group-open:rotate-180 on the Disclosure group).

drawer-lines.docs: The filled body of the CartDrawer: the lines with a quantity field, then the free-delivery bar, the subtotal and total and the button.

dropdown-item.docs: A menu item: an optional icon, the label and an optional trailing mark (a check for selected items). tabindex -1: the menu moves focus with the arrow keys.

editor-tab.docs: An editor file tab (40 px high): a file icon, the label and a close button. `preview` marks a tab that is not pinned yet. Keyboard (Enter and Space activate, Delete closes) is the programmer's behind the click and close events.

rows.desc: accessible name of the close button, e.g. "Close index.tsx"
rows.name: closeLabel

empty-panel.docs: An empty list or an empty search: a round icon, a title, a hint and an optional action, in a card or plain. Axes: layout (card, plain), actions (button, none), size (default, compact).

rows.desc: image: a picture instead of the round icon
rows.name: visual

empty-state.docs: Empty list or nothing found: a round icon, a title, a hint and an optional action.

error-page.docs: A page that tells the visitor something went wrong: an icon or a big code, a heading, a sentence and the way back. Axes: layout (centered, split: the picture beside the text), code (show, hide), actions mode (one, two), tone.

rows.desc: the way back: one link, or two (mode two)
rows.name: actions

faq-cards.docs: The questions of FaqSplit as cards: the topic, the question, the answer and a read-more link; with an icon square on top in the icons shape. Shapes: grid3, grid4, icons (three columns).

faq-disclosures.docs: The questions of FaqSplit as native disclosures, one open at a time.

rows.desc: the group name of the disclosures (one open at a time)
rows.name: name

faq-finder.docs: The finder of FaqSplit: a search field, the topics as a row of buttons, and the first three questions as popular links.

faq-help.docs: The help card beside the questions of FaqSplit: a title, a line of text, the ways to reach the team (icon, name, one line) and a link.

faq-list.docs: A section with a heading and the questions. Axes: layout (accordion: native disclosures that open without script; chat: question and answer as alternating bubbles), columns (1, 2), search mode (none, field: a search field above; the page filters by `search.query`), filter mode (none, categories: tabs above; the page filters by `filter.category`), density, tone.

rows.desc: the search field and its text
rows.name: search

rows.desc: the category tabs and the chosen one
rows.name: filter

rows.desc: true: several can be open at once; false: opening one closes the others (native details name)
rows.name: multiple

faq-split.docs: Questions in a split or as cards. Axes: layout (head: the heading and an action beside the disclosures, aside: the disclosures beside a help card, media: the disclosures and an action beside a picture, search: a finder beside a picture, cards: the questions as cards), cards (grid3, grid4, icons), mediaSide, tone.

rows.desc: a short pill above the heading
rows.name: badge

rows.desc: the ways to reach the team (aside layout)
rows.name: channels

rows.desc: the topic buttons of the finder (search layout)
rows.name: topics

feature-accordion.docs: Features as a list of disclosures: icon and title in the summary, the text when open. Axes: expand (first: the first one is open, none: all closed), media (none, image: a picture beside the list), tone, density.

rows.desc: true: several can be open at once; false: opening one closes the others (native details name)
rows.name: multiple

feature-cards.docs: The features as a grid of cards, tiles or bordered cells (the body of FeatureGrid). Icons are Lucide names.

rows.desc: card: icon, title and text stacked; tile: compact icon beside title and text; cell: bordered cell with a round icon
rows.name: item

feature-grid.docs: A section with a heading and the features as a grid of cards or tiles, or as rows with a picture. Icons are Lucide names. Axes: layout (grid, rows), columns, item (card, tile, cell: bordered tile with a round icon), media side (rows), density, tone.

rows.desc: card: icon, title and text stacked; tile: compact icon beside title and text; cell: bordered cell with a round icon
rows.name: item

rows.desc: rows layout: side of the picture; alternate swaps it every row
rows.name: mediaSide

feature-metric-cards.docs: Four figures of FeatureSplit as small cards in two columns: a glyph tile, the value with its hint and the label.

feature-pairs.docs: Four features of FeatureSplit in two columns: a glyph tile beside the title and text, without cards.

feature-rows.docs: The features as rows: text beside a picture (the rows layout of FeatureGrid). Icons are Lucide names.

rows.desc: side of the picture; alternate swaps it every row
rows.name: mediaSide

feature-showcase.docs: Features as cards under a centered heading. Axes: item (picture: a picture on top, then the title, the text and a read link; panel: a muted panel with a large glyph on top, then the title and the text), cols (3, 4), tone.

rows.desc: the word of the read link of the picture cards
rows.name: more

feature-split.docs: Features beside a picture. Axes: layout (grid: four plain features in two columns, cards: four features as cards and the actions, stats: two figure cards over three checked rows beside a square picture, metrics: four metric cards and the actions), mediaSide, tone.

rows.desc: a short pill above the heading
rows.name: badge

rows.desc: shown in the cards and metrics layouts
rows.name: actions

feature-stat-rows.docs: Two figures of FeatureSplit as cards, then three features as checked rows.

feature-sticky.docs: A picture that stays in view while the feature descriptions scroll beside it. `active` marks the description that is current (the page follows the scroll; that is a port contract). Axes: mediaSide (end, start), item (plain, card), tone, density.

feature-tabs.docs: Features behind a tab list: the chosen tab shows its text and a picture. The page keeps the chosen tab (`active`, empty for the first) and updates it on the `select` event. Axes: panel (split: text beside the picture, stack: picture below), tone, density.

rows.desc: id of the chosen feature; empty: the first
rows.name: active

field.docs: A form field: label, control (children), hint and error text. `htmlFor` ties the label to the id of the control.

rows.desc: when set it replaces the hint and is announced (role alert)
rows.name: error

file-tree.docs: The list of a file tree. Put FileTreeItem in it. Arrow keys and type-ahead: attach `moveFocus` and `typeahead` from the utils to the keydown (vertical, no loop).

file-tree-item.docs: A row of a file tree: a folder with a disclosure chevron, or a file. The glyphs are Lucide.

footer-brand.docs: The brand of FooterSplit: a mark and the brand word over the tagline.

footer-card.docs: The card layout of SitemapFooter: the brand mark and word, then the link groups in one row, in a rounded card.

rows.desc: accessible name of the link groups
rows.name: label

footer-channels.docs: The channels of the community as three cards: a glyph over the name and one line.

rows.desc: the figures, points, contacts and channels
rows.name: extras

footer-columns.docs: The link groups of SitemapFooter as columns: a group title over its links, up to five columns.

rows.desc: accessible name of the link groups
rows.name: label

footer-contacts.docs: The ways to reach the team in a column: a glyph tile, the kind (Email, Phone) and the value.

rows.desc: the figures, points, contacts and channels
rows.name: extras

footer-figures.docs: Three figures in a row under the brand of FooterSplit.

rows.desc: the figures, points, contacts and channels
rows.name: extras

footer-group-cards.docs: The link groups of FooterSplit as cards: a glyph and the group title over its links, four across on wide screens.

rows.desc: accessible name of the link groups
rows.name: label

footer-link-columns.docs: The first three link groups of FooterSplit as small columns beside each other.

rows.desc: accessible name of the link groups
rows.name: label

footer-points.docs: Four points with their glyphs in a column, under the tagline of FooterSplit.

rows.desc: the figures, points, contacts and channels
rows.name: extras

footer-signup-card.docs: The newsletter sign-up of FooterSplit in a card: a title with a glyph, the email field and button, and a note.

rows.desc: ties the email label to its field
rows.name: id

footer-split.docs: A footer with more than links. Axes: layout (stats: the brand with three figures and a sitemap link over the link groups as cards; points, links, newsletter, contacts, channels: a split beside a picture with the brand and four points, the brand and small link columns, a newsletter card and link columns, the contacts and two actions, or the community channels and figures), mediaSide, tone.

rows.desc: accessible name of the link groups
rows.name: label

rows.desc: the heading and text of the contacts, newsletter (loop) and channels (join) layouts, the sitemap link, the points title, the sign-up words and the two actions

form.docs: Form renders a vertical grid form container.
FormItem groups a single field with spacing for label and control.

grid.docs: GridCol renders one grid column child.

group.docs: Group renders a horizontal flex container.

hero-badge.docs: A composite badge on a dark band: an optional small mark beside a label.

hero-classic.docs: The top of a page: heading, lead and actions, with optional media (image, backdrop, code window, cluster). Axes: layout, media kind and side, scale, tone, density, actions mode.

hero-head.docs: The head row of a hero band: skip link, brand, menu links (the current one carries aria-current), login and a call to action.

hero-prompt.docs: A dark hero band: the head row, a badge, a title with weighted words, the prompt box (or actions) and topic pills.

hero-split.docs: A split hero: a badge, the heading, a lead, an extra under it and one or two actions, beside the media. hero-split-extras.docs: What HeroSplit shows under the lead: three figures in cards, a row of faces with a proof line, two small feature cards, or a quote with its author over three figures.

hero-split-media.docs: What HeroSplit shows beside the text: a picture, a picture with a floating card, a grid of four pictures with captions, or a picture with two plan cards floating over it.

rows.desc: the figures, small cards, people, proof line and floating card of the hero

icon-wall.docs: A dense grid of small tiles: an icon and a short label. Axes: columns (3, 4, 6), item (tile: icon above the label, chip: icon beside it), tone, density.

job-board.docs: Open jobs as cards in two columns, grouped by department, or as a table: the title, the department, the place, the type, an optional salary and an apply link. Axes: layout (grid, grouped, table), salary (show, hide), tone.

story-dots.docs: One dot per step of StoryTabs; the dot of the active step is filled.

story-panel.docs: The panel of the active step of StoryTabs: the year badge and the step count, the title, the text and the tag in a muted box.

story-tabs.docs: A story in steps (years or slides). Axes: layout (years: a row of year tabs over the panel of the active year with its badge, step, title, text and tag; carousel: the heading beside a picture with previous and next arrows and one dot per step), tone. Choosing a step emits `select`.

rows.desc: a short pill above the heading
rows.name: badge

rows.desc: the id of the step shown
rows.name: active

rows.desc: template step `Step {0} of {1}`; the accessible names of the arrows
rows.name: labels

support-channels.docs: Ways to get help as cards or rows, each with an icon, a title, a sentence and an open link. Axes: layout (grid, list), columns, action (link, none), tone (default, muted).

rows.desc: text of the link of each channel
rows.name: open

switch.docs: Switch renders input[type=checkbox] with switch role attrs.

switcher.docs: A segmented switcher: a tab list whose items (SwitcherItem) share size and layout. Canary handed these down through context; here each item takes the same two props. Arrow keys: attach `moveFocus` to the keydown (horizontal, activate).

switcher-item.docs: One item of a Switcher (default or active). Pass the same size and layout as the Switcher.

table.docs: Table renders the root table element.
TableHeadCell renders th with optional scope and abbr.

rows.desc: th scope: col, row, colgroup, rowgroup
rows.name: scope

table.docs: TableCell renders td with colspan and rowspan.

rows.desc: th scope: col, row, colgroup, rowgroup
rows.name: scope

table.docs: TableColGroup renders colgroup with optional span.
TableCol renders a single col definition.

table-toolbar.docs: The toolbar above a table: search and filter controls on the left (children), the actions on the right (`actions`). One tab stop group (role toolbar).

team-grid.docs: The people of a team: portrait cards, a minimal grid of small portraits, detailed cards with skills, rows beside a picture, or a directory of two columns. Axes: layout (cards, minimal, detailed, list, directory), cols, tone, density.

template-grid.docs: Template gallery: a heading, outline filter pills, a grid of template cards and a full-width browse-all button.

rows.desc: accessible name of the filter row
rows.name: filtersLabel

rows.desc: accessible name for the views count
rows.name: viewsLabel

rows.desc: accessible name for the likes count
rows.name: likesLabel

testimonial-grid.docs: Customer quotes as cards, plain figures or social posts, in a grid, a masonry, a scroll strip, one featured quote or one narrow column. Axes: layout (grid, single, stack, masonry, strip), columns, item kind (card, plain, social), item avatar, item rating, item mark (a company glyph), density, tone. A carousel is the Carousel port contract around the single layout.

rows.desc: the templates of the lines around a quote
rows.name: labels

rows.desc: single: the first quote only, wide; stack: one narrow column; masonry: columns of cards of any height; strip: one row that scrolls sideways
rows.name: layout

text.docs: Text renders a p element with body copy classes.

textarea.docs: Textarea renders a styled multi-line form control.

rows.desc: visible line count; defaults to 4 when zero
rows.name: rows

timeline.docs: A vertical list of events (an order's history): a dot on a line, the title, an optional text and the time. Newest first or oldest first is the caller's order.

rows.desc: tone is gray, green, blue, amber or red
rows.name: items

title.docs: Title renders the resolved heading element.

rows.desc: maps to h1–h6; 0 and 2 default to h2
rows.name: as

topic-chips.docs: A centered row of topic pills (static links). tone inverse: on a dark band with an icon per topic; default: outlined.

tour-callout.docs: One stop of a product tour: the element being explained and a callout beside it with a title, a sentence, the position in the tour and the buttons. Axes: placement (below, above, end: the callout sits beside the target), tone, density.

rows.desc: the name of the explained element, drawn as a button
rows.name: target

usage-calculator.docs: A price that follows a slider: the chosen amount of use, the price per unit and the estimate. The page keeps the amount and updates it on the `usage` event. Axes: layout (card, plain), ends (show: the smallest and the largest amount under the slider, hide), tone.

rows.desc: the range of the slider and its labels
rows.name: slider

rows.desc: how the estimate is computed and named
rows.name: price

usp-strip.docs: The promises of a store in one band: free delivery, returns, warranty, help. Axes: layout (strip: one muted panel, cards: a card each, bar: a thin line of icons and titles), tone, density.

rows.desc: section heading; empty: no heading (the section is named by id)
rows.name: title

video-grid.docs: Video testimonials as thumbnails: a picture, a play button, the name and the company. The player is a port contract (VideoEmbed); here the button emits `play`. Axes: columns (2, 3), caption (below, overlay), tone, density.

rows.desc: template of the play button's name, e.g. `Play the video from {0}`
rows.name: playLabel

rows.desc: template of the line under the name: `{0}, {1}` (role, company)
rows.name: byLine

video-modal.docs: A dialog with a walkthrough video: a title and a close button, the player area with a play button and, optionally, a list of chapters. Opening the dialog and playing the video are port contracts. Axes: size (default, wide), outline (none, chapters: a list under the player), tone.

rows.desc: accessible name of the close button
rows.name: close

rows.desc: accessible name of the play button
rows.name: play

weighted-title.docs: A display title, one span per word; word i takes weights[i] (from the preset). The words wrap like text.

rows.desc: id of the heading (the band is labelled by it)
rows.name: id

zone-rows.docs: The zones as a table (the table layout of ZoneTable): the zone and its areas, the price, free from, the minimum order, the time and an express badge.

zone-table.docs: Delivery zones and their prices as a table or as cards: the zone and its areas, the price, the order that ships free, the minimum order, the time and an express badge. Axes: layout (table, cards), tone, density.
